newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan gets four bids for export of basmati rice.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan gets four bids for export of basmati rice.

text.p: The Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan (RECP) said it had received four bids, the highest of which was $441 per tonne FOB, on Monday for the sale and export of 5,000 tonnes of basmati variety Pak-7 1996/97 (July-June) rice containing seven percent broken.
An RECP official said other bidders had quoted $437, $437 and $436.75 per tonne FOB. He did not identify them.
All the bids are for two lots of 2,500 tonnes each, he said.
The RECP reinvited bids after scrapping an earlier tender last month because it felt the three bids opened on May 26 were too low at $436, $435.10 and $425 per tonne FOB.
